name: Duncan
description: A reduced default for fast learning: a top bar, two rows of about 40 tools with the full sets one click away under each ▾, an icon rail with one panel beside it, a command line docked in the status strip, and nothing floating over the drawing. Every bar, group and panel can be torn off.
author: CadCraft (from Duncan Philips's interface mockup, BimCraft 0.2.0)
